Promotion and publishing

GEO promotion with expert content creation

GAEO researches your product, creates content and implements website changes or prepares specifications. Includes at least 50 prompts, 5 AI platforms and monthly monitoring.

from RUB 99,900/month

Monthly service

  • All core GEO promotion activities
  • From 50 prompts and 5 AI platforms

Discuss GEO + content

When to include content production

This plan suits businesses that need promotion but have limited time for regular content creation. I research the product, write the material and organize publication. You provide accurate offer details, supporting evidence and professional input where the subject requires it.

The plan includes intent mapping, at least 50 prompts and 5 AI platforms, distribution, link promotion and reputation work. I create the content myself and either implement agreed website changes or prepare specifications for your team.

Compare the plan where your team creates content →

What the material will address

Topics come from buyer questions. For a law firm, that might mean specific practice areas and engagement terms; for a fulfillment provider, product handling requirements; for a tour operator, itineraries and travel arrangements. Content explains when the offer fits the customer and what supports its claims.

Each piece has a purpose: to explain a service on the website, demonstrate a professional approach or provide external evidence of a specialization. Existing research, methodologies and cases are used when relevant. Publications connect to the appropriate services and industry pages.

GEO for fulfillment providers →GEO for travel businesses →GAEO publications and external materials →

From business facts to publication

I start with product descriptions, prices and terms, team information, documented results and existing material. We identify the appropriate expert to present the professional subject. Their actual experience and connection with the company should be clear to readers.

Once a draft is ready, we check factual accuracy and whether client examples can be published. I then organize publication and distribution. Formats and volume follow the agreed plan: one area may need a service page, while another benefits from a detailed buying guide or methodology.

The role of an expert author in AI visibility →

Connecting content with measured progress

Each month, I check visibility across the agreed matrix and examine how AI answers describe the business and its services. The meaning of the recommendation, accuracy of facts and cited sources matter. Those findings help choose the next topics and address gaps.

New products can be covered with additional prompt packs, while further AI platforms can broaden audience coverage. A separate plan ties part of the payment to a BMR target. Under that plan, I personally implement the website improvements and payment is tied to contractual BMR targets.

FAQ

Questions about this service

What is added to standard GEO promotion?+
I research the product, create and publish the content, and either implement website improvements or prepare specifications for your team. Intent mapping, external sources, reputation work and monitoring remain included.
Do we still need to help with content?+
Yes. Accurate product information and factual review are needed, particularly for professional claims, current terms and client stories.
How many articles will you create?+
Formats and volume are defined in the project plan. They depend on priority services, existing content and publication requirements; there is no universal article count for every business.
Does this include a new website?+
GEO + content includes implementing agreed changes to your existing site or preparing specifications for your team. Building a new website is a separate development service.
